_comment: Business settings — safe to edit from the GitHub web editor. Change a value, commit, done. If you make a typo the build fails and the LIVE SITE IS UNAFFECTED. See skills/ for step-by-step guides.

business.name: The Oven Vibe
business.tagline: Fresh, hot, oven-baked — made in Sundargarh

address._comment: 'street' must match the Google Business Profile address word-for-word. Carried over from the v1 site; verify it against GBP and fix it HERE (one place) if it differs.
address.street: Bijaya Talkies Road, In front of Subasini Clinic

hours._late_night_comment: Late-night (after 11:30 PM): big orders only, higher charges, limited menu (mostly pizza, sandwiches, fries) — call to arrange.

rating._comment: Keep these HONEST — copy the exact numbers from Google Business Profile. Never invent.

delivery.beyond_note: Beyond 4 km we deliver through Zomato and Swiggy — they cover the distance, we cook the food.

quiet_hours.note: Afternoon orders cost less to deliver, so they cost you less.

late_night.note: After closing we fire the oven again just for your order.
late_night.menu_note: Late night: no pasta or maggi — those stations are shut. Everything else is on.
late_night._availability_comment: What the kitchen STOPS cooking after closing (the boiling stations). Everything not listed here stays available. Categories cover future items automatically; unavailable_items is for one-offs inside a category that otherwise stays on.

rain.note: Only while it is actually raining — we turn it off when it stops.

campus_batch.note: Order together with a neighbour and you both pay ₹39.

regulars.note: Order three times and surcharges stop applying to you.
regulars._comment: Not offered on the public site: there is no system yet that tracks who is a regular, so a self-declared tick could not be verified. The kitchen applies this manually when it quotes. Re-expose it in the calculator and the FAQ once repeat customers are actually tracked.

delivery.radius_note: We deliver up to 4 km ourselves. Zomato and Swiggy carry the rest.
delivery._max_delivery_charge_comment: Ceiling on the SUM of every delivery-related charge - base fee plus late-night plus rain. Worst realistic stack is 2-4 km (69) + late night (79) + rain (29) = 177, so this caps it at 149. Raising a slab charge later cannot silently break the promise.
delivery._preorder_discount_comment: Taken off the food, not the delivery fee, so it still applies to pickup orders and never disappears when delivery happens to be free.

announcement._comment: Set 'text' to show a banner on every page (e.g. 'Closed today for Holi 🎨'). Set it back to empty "" to hide.

analytics._comment: Paste your Umami website ID from cloud.umami.is → Settings → Websites. Leave "" to disable analytics.
